items.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea adds Captain Jack, Megara, and Milo in underwater adventure
items.summary: The Keepsake Sea is an ocean and pirate-themed expansion coming this November to Disney Dreamlight Valley.
items.content:
As teased last month during D23 , Disney Dreamlight Valley has released the first official trailer for its next upcoming expansion, The Keepsake Sea . We also have a release date! Or month, at least. The Keepsake Sea will launch this November.

The Keepsake Sea is an ocean and pirate-themed expansion to the Disney life sim. The trailer confirms new characters Jack Sparrow (Pirates of the Caribbean), Milo (Atlantis), and Megara (Disney’s Hercules). Most expansions have added five new characters, and always include one major Disney villain as the antagonist.

Does Captain Jack count as a villain? Will we finally see Captain Hook’s arrival after Peter Pan and Tinkerbell ?

Shout out to Hercules , who did not have to wait long to get his partner in the game, even if she’s gated in an expansion.

Aside from new Valley villagers, Keepsake Sea also adds a full underwater biome to explore and decorate.

And we get there by transforming into mermaids! Which looks like it requires making a deal with Ursula.

It looks like other villagers can explore under the sea with their own personal submersibles. Ah, and here we were hoping to see mermaid-ified versions of each character.

Look for more details for The Keepsake Sea when developer Gameloft hosts a Showcase event later this year.

Gameloft released a smaller expansion, dubbed an Adventure Pack, earlier this year with Honeyglow Woods , adding characters from Winnie the Pooh, and a themed region around the Hundred Acre Woods. The last major expansion for Dreamlight Valley was last November’s Wishblossom Ranch , which added horses and horse-riding.

Disney Dreamlight Valley is available on PC (Steam, Epic), PlayStation, Switch, Switch 2, and Xbox, and rated E for Everyone.

items.title: Disney Just Dropped a Game-Changing Announcement — Literally!
items.summary: Just wait till you see this Disney Dreamlight Valley expansion!
items.content:
We have big news for Disney Dreamlight Valley fans! A new expansion pack is coming, and we may or may not be totally obsessed with it.

The new expansion, The Keepsake Sea , adds multiple new biomes to Dreamlight Valley. We’ve seen the teaser for the expansion, but now we have new details that we think every Dreamlight Valley fan is going to fall in love with.

There are tons of new features that are coming, including the ability to swim in a fully customizable mermaid or sea creature form . Players can swim “anywhere there is water” in the existing game and can dive for fish and items. It’s a nice change of pace for those who might not enjoy fishing as much, or who have been playing the game for years and want a different way to gather aquatic items.

The mermaid or sea creature you can be is fully customizable with tail and fin designs and colors. We loved the eel tail!

Players can also enter a portal to the new underwater area by swimming up to a mermaid statue that will appear off Dazzle Beach. This will transport players to the underwater area where you can find portals to other new biomes.

You’ll have full mobility to swim in the underwater areas by going up, down, left, and right. There are tons of collectibles there, and players can also build underwater with any of the furniture they have access to. You can build a house underwater! You can even build not only on the ocean floor but also on that vertical axis with the use of marine platforms that can be placed at any height. Floating houses? Say less!

Players will also be able to captain their own pirate ships to help reach some new areas. The pirate ships are customizable, and you can select up to two characters to sail with you as your crew. That means if you want to undertake a pirate ship with WALL-E and Daisy, you can.

New characters are also coming! Captain Jack Sparrow has been teased but is officially confirmed. He’s been a big request from fans! Milo from Atlantis and Meg from Hercules will also be joining the lineup. You can reunite Meg and Hercules, another fan request, and Milo and Captain Jack have a fun friendship. Milo is super excited that Jack knows a lot about the East India Trading Company. And yes, Jack Sparrow will have the iconic run.

A new critter will be joining the area and is a toucan! We saw Merlin around the area a lot in his Vacation outfit, which is currently available as a premium cosmetic item.

We are so excited for this expansion and to play! Make sure you keep following Disney Food Blog for more Disney news.

items.title: Disney Just Dropped A New Announcement And I’ve Never Been More Excited
Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea First Look – Mermaids, Pirates & More
Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea introduces mermaids and undersea building
items.content:
Feature Preview Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea introduces mermaids and undersea building Disney's cozy life sim is about to go under the sea.

Gameloft previously unveiled its agenda for the rest of Disney Dreamlight Valley's year. While new villagers are expected to move into the valley and new activities are set to take place, there's also a new expansion lined up. Announced during August's D23 Expo, panel attendees and stream viewers got a brief peek at The Keepsake Sea. What they may not have realized at the time was just how much this stands to change Disney Dreamlight Valley. I recently had a chance to check out the upcoming expansion during my time at Gamescom.

The Keepsake Sea will provide players with a first opportunity to dive below the waters bordering the valley. Since Disney Dreamlight Valley 's launch, players have explored this area at a surface level. They've collected items, gone fishing, and even gone through a few portals along this corner of the valley. For this expansion, it'll be possible to explore the area under the surface. Of course, the best way to explore underwater is to do so like a certain Disney princess and become a mermaid.

Through a deal with Ursula the Sea Witch, which players can be assured is totally on the up-and-up, it's now possible to explore underwater as a mermaid. Before getting into what undersea gameplay entails, the first thing to note is that a player's mermaid form will be totally customizable. It'll be possible to tweak fin patterns, colors, accessories, and other elements of a character's mermaid tail, allowing them to stand out when roaming under the sea. Gameloft hopes players can fully express themselves just as much with their mermaid forms as they can with their normal land forms.

Undersea exploration will pave the way for The Keepsake Sea's biggest feature: underwater building. Players will have the freedom to build and place structures deep beneath the sea's surface. In most cases, this will mean needing to build off a flat surface. Underwater layouts can be every bit as attractive as their surface counterparts. Of course, players are going to want to show off their work, so be aware that if you bring a character along with you below the water, they'll follow from the safety of a submarine. Gameloft will show off more of The Keepsake Sea's underwater building component as the expansion gets closer to release.

The undersea route will also lead to a new explorable area. On the other side is where players can encounter The Keepsake Sea's new characters. Meg, from Disney's Hercules, will be around, greeting players with her signature snark. Milo, from Atlantis: The Lost Empire (which is quite a deep Disney cut), will also be around, conducting research on the region's undersea phenomena. Finally, off in the distance is where players will find Captain Jack Sparrow, from Pirates of the Caribbean. All of these characters will have their own quest lines and will be happy to join the village once they're ready.

All of this is only a small taste of what players can expect from Disney Dreamlight Valley's next expansion, though the reveal of underwater building feels like a major game-changer and probably worth the price of admission alone. The Disney Dreamlight Valley development team will have more to say about what's next for the game in the weeks ahead. For now, expect Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea to arrive in November, as revealed by today's Nintendo Direct .

This preview is based on a developer walkthrough from a behind-the-scenes meeting at Gamescom 2026. The final product is subject to change.

items.content:
The creative minds behind the widely popular life-sim adventure game, Disney Dreamlight Valley came together at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event for the first time to celebrate a world filled with Disney magic, rich stories, and beloved Disney and Pixar characters.

Fans got a behind-the-scenes look at Disney Dreamlight Valley with moderator Courtney Shannon-Caines, community manager at Gameloft—who was joined on stage by Alexis McMullen, producer III on the Disney & Pixar Games team along with Gameloft’s Joshua Labelle, creative director, and Riley Wignall, lead narrative designer.

The team reflected on the success of Disney Dreamlight Valley and their creative approach to incorporating Disney and Pixar stories into the game, which includes the recently released Winnie the Pooh-inspired Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack and Pixel Perfect update inspired by Disney’s Wreck-It Ralph.

The Disney Dreamlight Valley panelists also gave fans an exclusive first look at what's to come throughout the rest of the year including:

To close out the panel, there was one last surprise for fans—an exclusive first look at Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea , the game’s fourth expansion pack. The teaser trailer offered a preview of the exciting adventure and sneak peek at a new character awaiting players later this year, which you can see here .

If you missed the panel at D23, you can also watch the full recording HERE .

items.title: Discover The Pixel Perfect Update!
items.summary: Hey, Valley Villagers! Get ready to power up your Valley with our latest update: Pixel Perfect, now available on all platforms! In this update, you'll get to team up with the Forgotten once again to investigate a series of mysterious glitch
items.content:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Get ready to power up your Valley with our latest update: Pixel Perfect, now available on all platforms!

In this update, you'll get to team up with the Forgotten once again to investigate a series of mysterious glitchy arcade machines appearing throughout the Valley. Follow the clues, uncover the source of the chaos, and help bring Ralph from Disney's Wreck-It Ralph to the Valley.

A Glitchy Mystery

To begin your journey, both the Forgotten and Peter Pan will need to be unlocked, and you need to have completed the quest "The Music's on the Walls."

As you investigate strange glitches appearing throughout the Valley, a mysterious arcade machine begins showing up in unexpected places. Complete the machine's strange requests to uncover its mysterious origins. 

What starts as a strange glitch quickly grows into a much bigger mystery. By following the clues, you'll discover the truth behind the arcade machine and help reunite Ralph with his friends in the Valley.

Arcade Adventures Await

Once Ralph settles back in, you'll help him get back into the swing of Valley life.

Help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make new friends, and settle into his new home. As you level up your Friendship with Ralph, you'll take part in arcade-inspired adventures, friendly competitions, scavenger hunts, and even help repair some unexpected chaos after Ralph accidentally causes a few glitches of his own.

Of course, no update centered around Friendship would be complete without some exciting new ways to spend time with your favorite Villagers.

Best Friends Forever

Friendship is getting a major upgrade in Pixel Perfect!

As of this update, Friendship Level 10 is evolving into something brand new: Best Friends! Strengthen your bonds with your favorite Villagers to unlock special perks, enhanced bonuses, and exciting new ways to spend time together throughout the Valley.

Want to learn more? Be sure to check out our dedicated Your Guide to Best Friends blog for a complete breakdown of the feature. 

Pop City Star Path

It's time to take center stage with the Pop City Star Path!

Transform your Valley with city-core items, vibrant lighting, stylish performance outfits, and rewards inspired by the excitement of live music.

Unlock standout rewards including luminous stage pieces, show-stopping fashions inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney's The Aristocats, and a lovable calico cat companion. 

Whether you're creating the perfect performance space or dressing for your next DreamSnaps entry, this Star Path is ready to steal the spotlight.

A Pixel Perfect Premium Shop

The Premium Shop is getting a stylish refresh with plenty of new ways to personalize your Valley.

Bring a splash of summer to your favorite Biomes with the new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle, featuring vibrant new looks for all iconic Valley locations. You'll also be able to light up your skies with the all-new Meteor Shower Sky Environmental Effect, perfect for creating magical DreamSnaps moments.

Additional highlights include the Scholarly Owl and Fantasia Broomstick companions, a new Village Schoolhouse House Style and matching Village Schoolhouse Kit, plus select Premium Shop bundles that now include premade Decoration Presets to help bring your dream designs to life even faster!

New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

Pixel Perfect introduces several highly requested decorating improvements designed to give you more creative freedom than ever before.

Expand your decorating possibilities with new Biome-inspired crafting recipes, beginning with a collection of whimsical furniture pieces themed around the Peaceful Meadow. You'll also be able to Quick Save your decorating progress while still in Edit Mode, helping ensure your latest creations are never lost.

Owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale will also be able to unlock three brand-new Floating Islands inspired by the Bind, Mythopia, and Everafter, using Story Magic, with even more room to build and decorate.

Olaf's Grand Exhibition Expands

Olaf's Grand Exhibition continues to grow with two brand-new rooms opening their doors as of this update.

Journey through the Sunlit Plateau- and Frosted Heights-themed Exhibition rooms, each featuring new collections to complete and rewards to unlock.

Continue celebrating your adventures throughout the Valley while showcasing even more of your favorite memories and accomplishments!

Valley Events

There are plenty of exciting events arriving throughout the Pixel Perfect update:

Summer Sizzle Event (August 5 – August 18)

Collect marshmallows, share delicious treats with friends, and complete daily quests to unlock brand-new rewards, including picnic baskets that can be gifted for Friendship XP or sold for Star Coins, as well as a kit that lets you build a boating dock for the first time ever! 

Parks Floating Festival (August 19 – September 8)

Explore a magical Floating Island inspired by Disney Parks, solve weekly puzzles, and earn enchanting rewards.

Memory Mania (September 16 – September 29)

Join Joy from Disney and Pixar's Inside Out for the return of Memory Mania. Complete new quests, spot differences in Memories, and unlock a brand-new companion.

We can't wait for you to welcome Ralph to your Valley and experience everything Pixel Perfect has to offer. Don't forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures by tagging us in your content.

items.title: Pixel Perfect Update Patch Notes
items.summary: Hey Valley Villagers! We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the Pixel Perfect free update in our latest \ video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update. In Pixel Perfect, you’ll once again team up wit
items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re thrilled to have shared a first look at the Pixel Perfect free update in our latest \ video! Now, let’s jump into the details of what you can expect in this update.

In Pixel Perfect, you’ll once again team up with The Forgotten, this time to fix an old arcade machine and bring Ralph, from Disney’s Wreck-It Ralph to your Valley! You’ll also be able to become Best Friends with your Villagers, upgrade your decorating skills with all new features and highly requested improvements, and much more!

Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Pixel Perfect free update arrives on July 29, 2026. Check out all the details below!

NEW CONTENT OVERVIEW

To kick off the events of Pixel Perfect, you’ll need to unlock The Forgotten and Peter Pan and complete the quest “The Music on the Wall”.

  • Join the Forgotten as you investigate a glitchy arcade machine near the Dream Castle. This glitchy relic will make a few more apparitions before ending up in Vanellope’s home.

    [/*]

  • Search your Valley for pies, root beer, and bricks that you’ll need to repair the arcade and set up a beacon to free Ralph!

    [/*]

  • Once setup in your Valley, help Ralph conduct a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, make some new friends, wreck a little mayhem, then fix it, to unlock awesome rewards!

    [/*]

  • Get ready to power up with the Pop City Star Path! Transform your Valley and put together a show for the stars with new luminous stage pieces and concert attires! Meet a new loveable feline companion, the paw-fect partner for this new Star Path, as well as two new outfits inspired by Marie and Berlioz from Disney’s Aristocats!

    [/*]

  • This update we’re also bringing back the Summer Sizzle event, from August 5th to August 18th, where you’ll collect marshmallows, share smores with your friends and complete daily quests around the Valley to unlock brand-new rewards – the first ever dock building.

    [/*]

  • Pixel Perfect will also feature a brand-new Parks Floating Festival! Arriving to the Valley from August 19th to September 8th, enter and explore the thematic floating island inspired by the best of Disney Parks to complete weekly puzzles and earn magical rewards.

    [/*]

  • Then from September 16th to September 29th, the Memory Mania event will return with new quests for you to complete alongside Joy from Disney’s Inside Out. Help spot the differences in memories, and you’ll be able to unlock a brand-new companion!

    [/*]

  • A new update means cool new swag! Coming to the Premium Shop is a brand-new Deluxe Tropical Valley Bundle that’ll give your Valley a splash of color with vibrant new looks for the Plaza, Dream Castle, Daisy’s Boutique, Chez Remy’s, Scrooge’s Store, and Valley Visit Station.

    [/*]

  • Alongside this new bundle arrives an all-new Environmental Effects item to the Premium Shop! The first of this kind is the Meteor Shower Sky - Fill your skies with cosmic showers, perfect for late night star watching or adding an extra radiant touch to your photos!

    [/*]

  • Get into the back-to-school spirit with a new Village Schoolhouse Skin, along with the matching Village Schoolyard Kit. Also coming this update is the charming Scholarly Owl companion and the new ionic Fantasia Broomstick companion.

    [/*]

  • In addition, we're bringing premade Presets to the Premium Shop. Select bundles, including some existing ones, will now arrive with premade Presets, allowing you to decorate your Valley with greater ease!

    [/*]

  • You’ll also want to keep an eye out on the Scrooge McDuck Store for brand-new weekly items such as Pink Leopard Tank Top, Dreamlight Varsity Jacket, Artist's Overalls, Enchanted Castle Tuxedo, Crimson Wayfinder Patterned Skirt, and more.

    [/*]

  • Seasonal Moonstone packs will also be available for a limited time.

    [/*]

Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or access to the Premium Shop.

UPDATE: We're happy to confirm that the Nintendo version of tomorrow's Pixel Perfect update will not contain the incompatible Clear Biome feature. Our team is still working on mitigating this issue for our Apple players.

The Pixel Perfect update was originally meant to include a "Clear Biome" feature in Furniture mode. Unfortunately, we discovered a critical bug in this feature last week, and have patched it out of the Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and Epic versions of the Pixel Perfect update. However, the feature will still be present in the Nintendo and Apple versions of the update and using it could impact various quests' progress. We recommend that our Nintendo and Apple players avoid using this feature for the time being. A hotfix will be deployed to patch the incompatible Clear Biome feature out of the Pixel Perfect update on Nintendo and Apple in the coming days. The feature will return in a later update.

FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS

OLAF’S GRAND EXHIBITION

New Exhibition Rooms

  • Finally, Olaf’s Grand Exhibition will be opening two brand new rooms for you to complete, centered on the Sunlit Plateau and the Frosted Heights. Both arriving with their own unique rewards for completion.

    [/*]

FRIENDSHIPS

General Improvements

We’ve revamped and improved how you engage with your Valley pals.

  • You’ll now be able to use Training Manuals to change any villager’s role, at any level.

    • We’re also revisiting crafting recipes to facilitate making Manuals!

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll also be able to select multiple individual items from your inventory to gift at once.

    [/*]

  • Speaking of gifts, you’ll now be able to re-roll each favorite gift, once per day.

    [/*]

New Friendship Perks

We’ve also updated the perks that come with leveling up your Friendships.

  • Level 7 friends will now also be able to assist you in gathering items! You will now be able to pick 1 item related to your friend’s base roles from any unlocked biome, and request that they collect more for you. The following day, you’ll be able to claim your item bundles from your friend.

    • There are no limits to how many friends you can request help from.

      [/*]

    • Friends will remain available in the Valley while they’re out searching for items.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • You’ll now also be able to use your Map to Fast Travel to any of your level 10 friends.

    [/*]

Best Friends!

As of Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to be Best Friends with your Valley’s villagers!

  • Once a villager reaches Level 10 Friendship, their Star Icon will be replaced with a Gold Heart progress bar. This progress bar, for all villagers, will reset daily and can only be filled once per day.

    [/*]

  • Once the new Gold Heart progress bar is filled, you’ll be able to hangout with your Best Friend and get limited time perks!

    • You and your Best Friend will have a Best Friend Glow that will last a limited time and will unlock max level roles bonus for ALL roles.

      [/*]

    • Sprinting will now affect your Best Friend Glow duration but not your Stamina.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Best Friends hangouts can only be had once per day, per villager.

    [/*]

DECORATING

New Crafting Recipes

Introducing new Biome-specific crafting recipes!

  • Complete crafter recipes utilizing ingredients from your base game Biomes to create unique furniture sets!

    [/*]

  • In Pixel Perfect, you’ll be able to complete a stunning array of new fae-inspired whimsical furniture pieces for your Peaceful Meadow.

    [/*]

Edit Mode Quick Save

  • To help reduce chances of lost decoration progress, you’ll now be able to “Quick Save” your ongoing decoration changes while still in Edit Mode, without having to “Save & Exit”.

items.title: Discover the Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack!
items.summary: Hey Valley Villagers, A brand-new cozy chapter begins today in Disney Dreamlight Valley as you step through a magical gateway into the Honeyglow Woods, a forgotten land where childhood memories, beloved friends, and the gentle magic of hone
items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers,

A brand-new cozy chapter begins today in Disney Dreamlight Valley as you step through a magical gateway into the Honeyglow Woods, a forgotten land where childhood memories, beloved friends, and the gentle magic of honey lingers just beyond the fog.

A Mysterious Invitation

Your journey begins with a mysterious package left in your mailbox, containing treasured childhood keepsakes and a curious little Tree Sprout. Once planted, the Tree Sprout grows into a magical gateway to the Honeyglow Woods itself.

But something isn't quite right.

A strange fog has settled across the Woods, and its once carefree residents have become separated from one another. To start setting things right, you'll meet Winnie the Pooh and work alongside him to uncover clues, clear the fog, and restore the warmth that once filled the Woods.

New Places & Beloved Friends

As you journey deeper into the Honeyglow Woods, you'll discover enchanting new places inspired by the world of Winnie the Pooh, each filled with its own atmosphere, secrets, and stories to uncover.

Wander through the flower-filled meadows of Drowsybloom Acre, splash through misty marshes in the Gloommeadow or brave the deeper woods hidden beyond the fog to eventually uncover the hidden Nectar Apiary, where the source of the Woods' troubles quietly waits.

Along the way, you'll share heartfelt moments with Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, and Piglet. Play games of hide-and-seek with Pooh, help Eeyore search for his missing tail, and encourage Piglet to find courage in the face of fear, all while restoring the warmth that once filled this magical place.

 

Cozy Adventures Beneath the Trees

Beyond the mist, the Honeyglow Woods are full of gentle surprises and cozy discoveries. Care for adorable hedgehogs, restore Busy Bees' Houses to unlock beekeeping adventures, and gather Golden Honey to craft recipes, furniture, and decorations inspired by the golden glow of the Woods.

Take part in playful moments like cloud-watching, rainy puddle-jumping, and Pooh Sticks along the riverbanks, where even the simplest activities become part of a shared adventure with your friends.

The Adventure Begins Today

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is available now as a standalone adventure pack or as part of the Honeyglow Woods Edition for new players looking to begin their journey.

Players who play Honeyglow Woods before July 22nd will also receive the exclusive Rainy Day Winnie the Pooh Dream Style delivered directly to their in-game mailbox.

We can't wait for you to step through the magical glowing tree, rediscover beloved friends, and uncover the adventure waiting within the Honeyglow Woods!

items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

This week, we celebrate 100 years of Winnie the Pooh with our new adventure pack Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods. We invite you to cross through a magical new gateway into a magnificent place, inspired by the Hundred Acre Wood, made up of four unique sub-biomes filled with mystery and magical honey!

Honeyglow Woods is the first ever Disney Dreamlight Valley adventure pack – a new optional paid add-on to be experienced alongside our usual free content updates. This is a new type of experience that allows us to create a unique adventure with thematic landscapes to decorate, a brand-new story, and a cast of loveable characters for those who wish to bring a little extra Disney magic to their Village. For more on this new type of experience, check out our adventure pack FAQ:

https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/faq_adventurepacks

Honeyglow Woods arrives on July 8th, 2026. Check out the details below.

NEW CONTENT (HONEYGLOW WOODS ADVENTURE PACK OWNERS):

  • Embark on this new adventure by planting a Tree Sprout until it grows into a magical glowing tree gateway that you’ll be able to place anywhere in your Valley or your base game Floating Islands – you’ll also be able to remove and/or replace this magical gateway at any time.

    [/*]

  • You’ll also have special new portals in Honeyglow Woods that will take you right to Scrooge McDuck’s Store and Chez Remy’s restaurant.

    [/*]

  • Once you’ve got your gateway placed cross over to the other side, but beware, something has gone very wrong in this place...  but don’t worry, you won’t be alone on the journey!

    [/*]

  • Reunite with Pooh Bear himself before finding Eeyore, and then finally Piglet!

    [/*]

  • Invite Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, and Piglet back to your Valley! They’ll of course arrive with their own homes, Friendship Quests and Rewards.

    [/*]

  • Discover all four new areas and solve the mystery of Honeyglow Woods: the Drowsybloom Acres, the Gloommeadow, Braveheart Grove, and the Nectar Apiary.

    [/*]

  • Make use of the abundance of honey for new honey-based recipes and furniture, like Warm Milk & Honey, Hunnycrunch Bar, Poohs Birthday Cake, Honeypot Lamp, Cozy Honeyleaf Rug, and so much more! 

    [/*]

  • Discover a brand-new gameplay mechanic, Beekeeping! Place flowers around a Busy Bees’ House, to pollinate the flowers and generate more honey in the houses – a fully pollinated Busy Bees’ House will increase the growth speeds of other nearby flowers!

    [/*]

  • You'll also be able to move these Busy Bees’ Houses to any of your other biomes, including your base game Valley!

    [/*]

  • Keep your eyes peeled for the absolutely adorable Hedgehogs! These new little cuties will come with their own Photo Mode poses!

    [/*]

  • Try interacting with a Honeyglow bridge in the Gloommeadow to play Pooh Sticks! A new and unique way to interact and level up your Friendship Level with your villagers and unlock their exclusive rewards!

    [/*]

  • For those of you already playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, you'll be able to enjoy Honeyglow Woods on all platforms. What's more, you'll get 2,000 Moonstones to spend however you please!

    [/*]

  • If you're brand new to Disney Dreamlight Valley, you can get Honeyglow Woods AND the base game with 10,000 Moonstones! (Psst, that's a special currency you can spend on exclusive furniture and clothing in our Premium Shop.) 

    [/*]

  • Finaly, if you embark on this new adventure before July 22nd, you’ll also unlock an exclusive Rainy Day Winnie the Pooh Dream Style in your in-game mailbox with your purchase!

    [/*]

Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition owners will have access to the contents of the Honeyglow Woods adventure pack on day one without the need for additional purchase.

LAUNCH DAY TWITCH DROPS (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS)

For the release of this exciting new adventure pack, we’re launching a new Twitch Drops activation!

From July 8th at 10:00 AM EDT to July 15th at 9:59 AM EDT, you can head over to the following partnered creators and watch their Disney Dreamlight Valley streams to unlock Piglet’s Clothesline!

For participation and partnered creators’ details, visit our website:

https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/twitch-drops

items.title: Catch Up on the Disney Dreamlight Valley 2026 Summer Showcase Stream!
items.summary: Hey, Valley Villagers! Today, we had the absolute pleasure of announcing a totally unique adventure with the Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack, arriving on July 8, 2026! We then pulled back the curtains and peeked at
items.content:
Hey, Valley Villagers!

Today, we had the absolute pleasure of announcing a totally unique adventure with the Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack, arriving on July 8, 2026! We then pulled back the curtains and peeked at some of the upcoming free updates you can expect in the back half of the year.

If you missed the Summer Showcase stream, the best way to catch up is by watching it right here:

Welcome to the Honeyglow Woods

Celebrate 100 years of Winnie the Pooh on July 8 with our brand-new adventure Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods!Cross through a magical new gateway into the titular Honeyglow Woods, a land inspired by Winnie the Pooh, filled with puzzles, lost secrets, and a fair share of honey. 🍯

The Honeyglow Woods were once a place where you could enjoy just doing nothing... at least until the Everoak Tree at the center of the Woods closed up.

To embark on this new adventure, you'll need to plant a Tree Sprout until it grows into a magical glowing tree that you'll be able to place anywhere in your Valley, your Floating Islands, or your Expansions—you'll also be able to remove and/or replace this magical gateway at any time. Once you've crossed over to the other side, you'll notice something has gone very wrong in this place... But don't worry, you won't be alone on the journey!

The Friends You Make Along the Way

Soon you'll reunite with Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, and Eeyore to return to the fun, carefree days of childhood!

First, you'll meet the Pooh Bear himself: Winnie the Pooh! Spend some time playing hide-and-seek and watching the clouds go by, then uncover the magic of honey—magical honey that is! Oh, and well, it looks like Eeyore has lost his tail again. Help this delightfully gloomy donkey find a new tail until you can find the real one. Lastly, help the courageous Piglet face his fears, and reunite the trio!

Before you know it, you'll be able to invite Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, and Piglet back to your Valley! They'll of course arrive with their own homes, Friendship Quests and rewards... but first you'll want to solve the mystery of the Honeyglow Woods.

A New Magical Land, with Magical Honey

This magical place, inspired by the Hundred Acre Wood, was where you would spend splendid lazy summers as a kid. It represents a new space to decorate and make your own with four special new areas to discover and progress through.

First is the Drowsybloom Acre, a sunny meadow perfect for napping and smelling flowers. Then there's the Gloommeadow, a murky marsh full of ponds, puddles, and rivers. There's also Braveheart Grove, a dense forested area where you (and Piglet) will face your fears. Finally, there's the Nectar Apiary, a hidden glen filled with honeycombs where you'll find the source of the troubles!

To get to the Honeyglow Woods, you'll use the previously mentioned magical glowing tree. You'll also have special new portals in the Honeyglow Woods that will take you right to Scrooge McDuck's Store and Chez Remy's restaurant.

Speaking of food, in the Honeyglow Woods, you'll be able to use the honey from the bee boxes to unlock new honey-based recipes and furniture, like Warm Milk & Honey, Honeycrunch Bar, Pooh's Birthday Cake, Honeypot Lamp, Cozy Honeyleaf Rug, and so much more!

But wait, that's not the only way you'll be able to use honey! This Adventure Pack also contains a brand-new gameplay mechanic: beekeeping! By placing flowers around a Busy Bees' House, they'll get pollinated, which will generate more honey in the houses. In addition to this, a fully pollinated Busy Bees' House will double the growth of flowers in the same Biome up to their spawn limit. You'll also be able to move these Busy Bees' Houses to any of your other Biomes, including your base game Valley! 

And of course, no new lands in Disney Dreamlight Valley would be complete without a new kind of critter... behold the absolutely adorable hedgehogs! These little cuties will come with their own Photo Mode poses and Friendship Levels to unlock!

The Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack also introduces a new mini-game: Pooh Sticks! By interacting with a Honeyglow bridge in the Gloommeadow, you'll be able to aim and drop a stick (and other items) to race them down the river. This is a new and unique way to interact and level up your Friendship Level with your Villagers and unlock exclusive rewards!

The Adventure Pack and Early Adopter Bonus

The Honeyglow Woods is the first ever Disney Dreamlight Valley Adventure Pack—an optional, paid new add-on to be experienced alongside our usual free content updates. Diving into this sort of adventure allows us to create a unique experience inspired by one beloved universe with thematic landscapes to decorate, a brand-new story, and a cast of lovable Characters for those who wish to bring a little extra Disney magic to their Village. For more on this new type of experience, check out our Adventure Pack FAQ: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/faq_adventurepacks

For those of you already playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, you'll be able to enjoy the Honeyglow Woods on all platforms or purchase this new adventure in the Premium Shop. What's more, you'll get 2,000 Moonstones to spend however you please!

If you're brand-new to Disney Dreamlight Valley, you can get the Honeyglow Woods AND the base game with 10,000 Moonstones! (Psst, that's a special currency you can spend on exclusive furniture and clothing in our Premium Shop.) 

For anyone playing either the standalone Adventure Pack or the bundled edition with the base game before July 22, you'll also receive an exclusive Rainy Day Winnie the Pooh Dream Style in your in-game mailbox with your purchase!

Disney Dreamlight Valley Apple Arcade Edition owners will have access to the contents of the Honeyglow Woods Adventure Pack on day one without the need for an additional purchase.

What's Next?

We're already halfway through the year, but we're just getting started! Later this summer, you'll meet a long-awaited Villager: Ralph, from Disney's Wreck-It Ralph, who will finally be joining Vanellope in the Valley!

Ralph will arrive in the Valley with some help from the Forgotten. Get swept into video game nostalgia as you help Ralph run a Bad-Anon meeting, reconnect with Vanellope, and more! This update will also include a new Star Path, features, and quality-of-life improvements—we'll have more info coming soon!

Then later in the year, you can expect two more free base game updates, and a new Disney Dreamlight Valley Expansion... But we'll dive into that at a later date. 😉

Community House Style

We're thrilled to announce a new community activation where you can have your say on what kind of House we should be adding to the Valley later this year!

Use the link below to start voting—all rounds are open until June 26!

https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/community-house-voting

Twitch Drops

Last but not least, this Summer Showcase also kicked off a new Twitch Drops activation!

From today, June 17, until June 24,you can watch our partnered creators' Disney Dreamlight Valley streams to unlock an Eeyore Ears Headband!

For participation and partnered creators' details, visit our website:

disneydreamlightvalley.com/twitch-drops

_________________________________________________________

We can't wait for you to experience everything in this new Adventure Pack when Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods launches on July 8, and for you to welcome Ralph to your Valleys in our free content update. Thank you for taking part in this magical journey with us!

See you in the Valley, and the Honeyglow Woods!

items.title: Discover The Path of the Hero Update
items.summary: Hey Valley Villagers, Prepare for an epic new adventure with our latest update: The Path of the Hero, now available on all platforms! Step into a brand-new Realm and embark on a series of heroic trials to uncover the mystery behind the rest
items.content:
Hey Valley Villagers,

Prepare for an epic new adventure with our latest update: The Path of the Hero, now available on all platforms! 

Step into a brand-new Realm and embark on a series of heroic trials to uncover the mystery behind the restless gods and help guide Hercules from Disney’s Hercules back to your Valley, working alongside his legendary mentor Phil from Disney’s Hercules.

A Realm Worthy of a Hero

To begin your journey, unlock the Hercules Realm and explore Phil’s training island.  The moment you arrive, it’s easy to see that something’s not quite right. Dark Thorns have started to appear, and a mysterious fog has settled over the woods.

With Hercules nowhere to be found after heading deeper into the forest, it’s up to you to follow the trail and discover what’s happened.

Train like a Hero

To make sure you’re strong enough to chase Hercules into the fog, Phil has prepared special training challenges. Take on obstacle courses where you’ll clear Dark Thorns, activate Moonlight Beacons, and collect rewards as you prove your skills.

As you progress, unlock new abilities and divine tools that will help you on your journey. Travel through shadowed forests, across perilous cliffs, and into an ancient temple. Along the way, earn the favor of different gods through troubled terrain, and ultimately solve the mystery of who caused the chaos in the Realm in the first place.  When you’re done, you’ll guide Hercules and Phil back to the Valley.

Godly Glamor Star Path

Channel your inner deity with the Godly Glamor Star Path, where myths meet elegance.

Earn radiant new outfits, divine-inspired furniture, and mythical companions as you progress through your journey. From glowing celestial designs to majestic decor fit for the gods, every reward will bring a touch of Olympus to your Valley.

Also unlock standout rewards such as the Mythical Cloud Glider, Pink Baby Pegasus companion, Hercules’ Divine Glow Dream Style, and the Olympian Cloud Mansion House Style.

A Heroic Update to the Premium Shop

The Premium Shop is getting a heroic refresh with new items inspired by the world of Hercules and the gods.

Step into mythic style with the Gilded Agora Building Kit, featuring the majestic Grecian Villa House Style, and the ability to summon a fierce new ally with the “good-good-good” puppy Cerberus companion. 

You’ll also find the new Cozy Companion Rajah Bundle, featuring Rajah, Jasmine’s loyal companion, bringing unique interactions with Aladdin and Jasmine, Photo Mode poses, an exclusive friendship reward, and even a Tiger Cub companion. 

Additional highlights include a new Dream Style for Ariel, Moana’s parade float, and new mount accessories arriving in the Shop.

New Ways to Decorate Your Valley

We’re introducing Decoration Presets, a brand-new way to decorate your Valley with ease.

This feature works alongside Group Mode and allows you to select a section of your Valley and save it as a Preset. You can then remove, copy, and replace fully decorated areas whenever you like.

If you don’t own enough of an item in a saved Preset, a Mirage placeholder will appear, letting you quickly craft or purchase what’s missing and place it instantly.

\

Olaf’s Grand Exhibition Expands

Olaf’s Grand Exhibition is growing with two new rooms arriving in this update: the Forest of Valor and the Glade of Trust.

Continue building your collection and celebrate your Valley journey by showcasing even more of your favorite memories and achievements.

Valley Events

There are two exciting events arriving with the The Path of the Hero Update for you to enjoy in the Valley:

Dreamlight Parks Fest (June 10 – June 30)

Celebrate the return of the Dreamlight Parks Fest! Collect buttons throughout your Valley to earn returning favorites as well as brand-new rewards.

Picture Pursuit Event (July 15 – July 28)

Embark on a new photographic adventure. Complete daily quests, find mysterious motifs, and capture them in photos to unlock exclusive rewards, including a new Photo Mode frame!

We can’t wait for you to explore all the heroic adventures The Path of the Hero has to offer! Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures by tagging us in your content.
